title: Scan a ticket
readyNext: Tap to scan the next one
subtitle: Check each ticket at the door.
armedHint: Scan a ticket, or type its code.
cameraAim: Hold the ticket inside the frame
cameraDeniedHint: Allow the camera in the browser settings, then try again. Or type the code.
advice_notFound: Check the code, or send them to the counter.
advice_alreadyRedeemed: This ticket was already used. Send them to the counter.
advice_voidRefunded: This ticket was cancelled or refunded. Send them to the counter.
advice_replaced: This is an old code. Ask for the new ticket, or send them to the counter.
advice_terminated: The venue cancelled this ticket. Send them to the counter.
noScansYet: Nothing scanned on this device yet.
